'badgeColor + '20'' produces invalid CSS in Promotions and Listing Preview — badge backgrounds will be transparent. Use -surface tokens directly or hardcode resolved hex values.

Promotions CSSToggle aria-label is generic for every toggle — change to `Toggle ${promo.name}` so screen readers can distinguish between promotions.
#166534 hardcoded green in Settings (SecurityTab, BillingTab) and Integrations (Connected badge) — replace with var(--db-success).
role='banner' misuse in Listing Preview preview notice — conflicts with actual page header landmark. Change to role='note' or remove the role.
No test coverage for any of the five new pages — Rates bulk-uplift math, Promotions form validation, and Settings password validation are pure client-side logic with no tests.
